value.signature: fn decode_material (input : & [u8] , context : & MaterialContext) -> Result < AuthenticationMaterial , EncodingError >

review.body: { let value = canonical (input , MATERIAL_LIMIT) ? ; let [edition , run , actor_key , host_identity , host_key] = items (& value) ? else { return Err (EncodingError :: Shape) ; } ; let edition = string (edition) ? ; let result = AuthenticationMaterial { run : fixed (run) ? , actor_key : fixed (actor_key) ? , host_identity : string (host_identity) ? . into () , host_key : fixed (host_key) ? , } ; if edition != AUTHENTICATION_EDITION { return Err (EncodingError :: Edition) ; } check_material (& result , context) ? ; Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Supplied public material bytes are checked against an independently supplied run, act, host and version context.
